subject: Nimbus Health — private deployment commissioning logistics & evidence checklist
messages:
From: Claire Bolton <claire.bolton@nimbushealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@infra-consultants.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Nimbus private deploy — initial evidence & contact list

Hi Diego,

Thanks for taking this on. We're moving faster than expected on the Nimbus private deployment and need a concise checklist of account activation tasks and evidence we must supply this week so we can schedule the production cutover. High-level asks from our side:

- Exact VPC/subnet allocation and egress IP allowlist to provide to our networking team
- KMS/HSM key escrow requirements and template for key ownership statements
- SOC2 / audit-log evidence you'll need (time windows, retention expectations)
- Any DocuSign or procurement artifacts we should expect to sign
- On-call/resolution SLOs for the first 30 days post-cutover

Can you send a single checklist + owner matrix and the account numbers we should reference when provisioning? Samir is our infra consultant and will handle the VPC peering work.

Thanks,
Claire
Director of IT Operations
Nimbus Health

Attachments: none

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bolton <claire.bolton@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <samir@infra-consultants.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Dec 2028 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Nimbus private deploy — initial evidence & contact list

Claire —

Appreciate the clear ask. I've attached a concise commissioning checklist ("nimbus-infra-prereqs-v1.xlsx") and a first-pass network diagram ("nimbus-network-diagram-v1.pdf"). Below is the owner matrix and immediate next steps so you can assign internally this morning:

Immediate owners & actions (week 1):
- Nimbus networking (Samir) — provide allocated CIDR blocks and public egress ranges we should expect; share the NAT/Gateway plan (due EOD Thu)
- Ben Carter (Redwood networking lead) — will confirm peering approach and required route tables; will send a port/endpoint allowlist for the runtime controller by Wednesday
- Marissa Cole (Redwood Ops) — will prepare KMS key-handover template and audit-log retention evidence checklist
- Kimberly Park (Redwood Compliance) — will collate SOC2-related evidence we can share and any redaction guidance

Account references for provisioning:
- Redwood Private tenant id: rwd-NU-4521
- Project tag: nimbus-prod-4521
- Temporary access expiry: set to 2029-01-09 by default (we can extend when you confirm)

Operational SLOs for day 0-30 (summary):
- P1 response: 1 hour (24/7), P2: 4 hours (business hours SLA), P3: 24 hours
- Weekly sync for runbook handoff during ramp (first 3 weeks)

I've invited Ben/Marissa/Kimberly on the thread to add specifics; Ben — can you attach the port allowlist and call out when you need the egress ranges from Nimbus? Marissa/Kimberly — please add the KMS and evidence templates.

Thanks,
Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimbus-infra-prereqs-v1.xlsx, nimbus-network-diagram-v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bolton <claire.bolton@nimbushealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@infra-consultants.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Nimbus private deploy — initial evidence & contact list

Claire / Samir —

Quick network note and attached port/endpoint allowlist (inline summary below). Samir — I marked the lines where we need your public egress ranges to finalize CIDR mappings.

Port / endpoint summary (runtime):
- Controller API: outbound TCP 443 -> controller.redwood.internal (we use mTLS; you only need IPs for egress allowlist)
- Runtime worker egress: TCP 443 for model fetches and telemetry (SNI required)
- KV cache peers: TCP 2024 (internal) — requires VPC peering and route table entry
- Optional debug SSH tunnel (rare): TCP 22022 (only for scheduled debug windows)

Attachment: nimbus-network-diagram-v1.pdf (high-level peering and subnets)

Samir — can you push the egress ranges to this thread once you have them? I need them to produce the final route table and NAT config.

Thanks,
Ben
Network Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-port-allowlist-20281205.csv

From: Samir Rao <samir@infra-consultants.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Claire Bolton <claire.bolton@nimbushealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Dec 2028 13:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Nimbus private deploy — initial evidence & contact list

Ben / Diego / Claire —

We pushed preliminary egress ranges from Nimbus's edge NAT pool:
- 54.214.120.0/24
- 54.214.121.0/24
- 54.214.122.128/25

Samir (on Nimbus side) will validate exact source IPs from the staging environment and update if we enable additional egress appliances. Also tagging a couple questions from our networking team:
1) Do you require specific TCP/UDP ephemeral port ranges for session pinning?
2) Is mutual TLS enforced for controller connections, or can we allow TLS with IP verification initially?

Claire — once you confirm, Ben will finalize the route tables and we can schedule a short run-through with Redwood Ops.

—Samir

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bolton <claire.bolton@nimbushealth.com>, Samir Rao <samir@infra-consultants.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Dec 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Nimbus private deploy — initial evidence & contact list

Claire —

Thanks for the quick replies and Samir for the egress ranges. To close out the commissioning prework and move to scheduling the cutover, items outstanding and owners below (target: complete by Wed 2028-12-13):

Outstanding checklist (summary):
- Nimbus: confirm if mTLS required for controller (answer: yes/no) and provide any ephemeral port constraints (owner: Claire / Samir)
- Ben (Redwood): final route table + peering confirmation once egress ranges are locked
- Marissa (Redwood): send KMS key-handover template (attached) and the exact list of SOC2 artifacts we can share; will include retention windows and log schemas
- Kimberly (Redwood): assemble a redaction checklist for PHI-sensitive items we cannot export in raw logs
- Claire/Samir: sign account provisioning DocuSign (link below) referencing tenant id rwd-NU-4521

DocuSign provisioning link: https://www.docusign.com/initiations/NU-4521-sign
Evidence folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xnimbus-infra-evidence

I've attached the KMS template used for prior customers (kms-key-handover-template.docx). Once everyone confirms, I'll schedule the 60-minute cutover walkthrough and publish the runbook.

If there are any procurement or marketplace billing items AWS needs to surface, I've cc'd AWS Marketplace so we can expedite the listing and invoicing steps.

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms-key-handover-template.docx
